mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, workspace_id, session_id, created_by, template_code, raw_prompt, optimized_prompt, context_snapshot, result_metadata, permission_policy, latency_ms, retention_until, deleted_at, created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT id, template_code, left(btrim(replace(replace(raw_prompt, chr(13), ' '), chr(10), ' ')), 161) AS raw_prompt, jsonb_build_object( 'provider', result_metadata -> 'provider', 'model', result_metadata -> 'model', 'modelVersion', result_metadata -> 'modelVersion', 'mock', result_metadata -> 'mock' ) AS result_metadata, latency_ms, created_at FROM optimization_record
ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO optimization_record ( id, tenant_id, workspace_id, session_id, created_by, template_code, raw_prompt, optimized_prompt, context_snapshot, result_metadata, permission_policy, latency_ms, retention_until, deleted_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{record.id}, #{record.tenantId}, #{record.workspaceId}, #{record.sessionId}, #{record.createdBy}, #{record.templateCode}, #{record.rawPrompt}, #{record.optimizedPrompt}, CAST(#{record.contextSnapshot,typeHandler=com.promptoptimizer.common.persistence.JsonbObjectTypeHandler,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{record.resultMetadata,typeHandler=com.promptoptimizer.common.persistence.JsonbObjectTypeHandler,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{record.permissionPolicy,typeHandler=com.promptoptimizer.common.persistence.JsonbObjectTypeHandler,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{record.latencyMs}, #{record.retentionUntil}, #{record.deletedAt}, #{record.createdAt} )
